map. Its battle is gated on the same job models as level 1 (琥 jobBowMan 83,
dual controlled slots); the STORY002 opening — the fleeing raiders, the
mercenaries catching up — is remade as a preview that stops at first control.
STORY002 opens on actPlayLevelMusic: the original table 0x477b44 gives level 2
track 12 (static-derived byte read; see the evidence packet).

戈爾山道 (the hand-off world state keeps current_point 2). winfail002's win
actions (緹娜 joins, point 3 / track flags, next level 3) are not applied.
